data.raw_text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR JHIRI MELA 2025 https://t.co/JILD1JMreE

data.cleaned_text: [4:30PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate Large turnout of vehicles and pedestrians attending an event at Mobolaji Johnson Arena has led to significant congestion along King George IV road, Onikan roundabout. backlog of traffic has gone back to Bonny camp. Movement from zone 2 underneath the bridge is also slow due to alternation at the intersection. Officers strategically positioned managing the resultant effect of the event. #FollowLASTMA
